name: join-multi-column-order
description: Benchmark chained JOIN ORDER BY keys and mixed sort direction

queries.name: country-then-event
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.country, e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: tier-desc-event-asc
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.tier DESC, e.event_id ASC LIMIT 20

queries.name: country-asc-event-desc
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.country ASC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 20
